name: Выхухоль
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon Russian DESMAN (vyhuhol) character, long flexible trunk-snout, tiny eyes, webbed pink feet, sleek waterproof brown fur, brave curious face.
world: deep-water exploration — free-diving, brass diving helmets, bathyscaphes, sunken ruins and bioluminescence
scenes: a young desman by a quiet pond edge in a homemade shell diving-mask, three-quarter view, curious.
wading into the shallows with a handheld lantern and a satchel of finds, side view.
diving in a full brass helmet and suit among glowing jellyfish, holding a tool, low upward angle.
in a round bathyscaphe porthole, deep water with ruined coral towers beyond the glass.
riding a great manta ray down a dark ocean trench, dynamic diagonal composition.
a colossal LEVIATHAN-guardian of the deep coiling over a sunken golden city, godrays, NO wings.

name: Сойка
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon EURASIAN JAY character, pinkish-brown body, a bright blue-barred wing patch, a black moustache stripe, clever curious eyes.
world: art and shiny-treasure — a jay that hoards glass beads, paints, and curates a gallery
scenes: a young jay tilting its head to pick up a shiny glass bead in its beak, on a sunlit branch.
at a little easel with a palette and a satchel of glittering trinkets, painting, cozy nook.
a stained-glass artist arranging floating glass shards into a picture, light streaming through.
a gallery curator in a fine robe presenting a levitating masterpiece frame, a bright hall.
a master painter sweeping a giant luminous mural across the sky with broad wing-strokes.
a radiant SPIRIT-GALLERIST, wings a mosaic of stained-glass light, holding a golden brush, cathedral of glass.

name: Хомяк
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon HAMSTER character, round fluffy golden-brown body, hugely stuffed cheeks, tiny clever paws, a sly confident merchant smile.
world: eastern spice-bazaar trade — market stalls, caravans, brass scales, coins and spice
scenes: a hamster kid at a tiny seed stall made of a wooden crate, three-quarter view, sunny bazaar corner.
a street vendor in an apron weighing saffron on a tiny brass scale, colourful spice trays, side view.
a caravan trader in a silk vest leading a loaded snail-cart through a market archway, wide shot.
a wealthy merchant-prince on a plump cushion amid heaps of goods and coins, an ornate lantern-lit stall.
a bazaar magnate arms-spread atop a mountain of carpets and crates, a market crowd below.
a golden SULTAN of trade on a throne of coins and spice-mountains, a jewelled turban, NO wings.

name: Козодой
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon NIGHTJAR bird character, soft mottled grey-brown camouflage plumage, huge round dark eyes, a wide tiny beak, a dreamy calm face.
world: astronomy and star-charting — spyglasses, brass telescopes, constellations and the night sky
scenes: a fledgling nightjar peering up through a tiny handmade spyglass on a mossy branch, starry night.
a young stargazer with a rolled star-chart and a lantern on a fencepost, mapping the sky, side view.
a celestial cartographer drawing constellations in the air with a quill of light, floating star-motes.
an observatory keeper beside a great brass telescope on a cliff, a whole galaxy swirling overhead.
a reader of the heavens on a floating platform among streaking comets, a cloak woven of star-maps.
a DEITY OF THE NIGHT SKY cradling a small galaxy, a robe of living constellations, NO spread wings.

name: Ёрш
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon RUFFE fish (yorsh) character, a spiky dorsal fin like a punk mohawk, olive-bronze scales, big attitude eyes, a cocky grin, floating in stylized water.
world: street rock music — electric guitars, stages, amps and electric sound-waves
scenes: a little ruffe busking on a cardboard-box drum in a puddle-alley, three-quarter view, cheeky.
a garage-band fish in a beanie strumming a mini electric guitar, a tiny bubble-amp rig, side view.
a rising star in shades shredding a guitar, rings of sound-waves, a small underwater club stage.
a rocker mid-jump with a double-neck guitar, stage pyros bursting, dynamic low angle, a crowd of bubbles.
a stage-god flooding a packed arena with electric riffs, sweeping spotlights, extreme motion.
a golden ROCK ICON on a stage, a guitar of pure light, a sound explosion, an adoring sea of lights, NO wings.
